name: Fermented fish
summary: Fermented fish of the Thái, set on the table with pa pỉnh tộp, hearth meat, and tương thúa ố.
origin: Báo Sơn La, 9 September 2025 and 1 April 2022.
where: The Thái table, and the Đà reservoir communities on the 1 April 2022 account.
seoTitle: Mam ca in Son La — fermented fish
seoDescription: Mẳm cá in Sơn La. Báo Sơn La names it for the Thái and for Thái and Mường communities on the Đà reservoir.
